data.name: Geoffry
data.long_meaning: Geoffry is derived from Old French Geoffroi, which means 'ploughman' or 'god-given ploughman'. The name is rooted in Germanic Gaufrid, which translates to 'ploughman' and 'god-given'. In the Middle Ages, this name was popular among knights and farmers who embodied the virtues of hard work and faith.
